session.title: Ridge in Action: A Worked Numerical Example
session.description: This session walks through a step-by-step numerical calculation of a Ridge Regression model, demonstrating how the L2 penalty term modifies the standard OLS coefficients. By completing this session, you will be able to trace the math of the shrinkage process and understand exactly how the tuning parameter lambda controls the trade-off between fitting the data and keeping coefficients small. This practical application bridges the gap between the theoretical L2 formula and real-world model stabilization.
keyPoints: Setting up the OLS objective function with the added L2 penalty term.
Calculating the 'shrunk' coefficients using a simple bivariate dataset.
Comparing OLS estimates versus Ridge estimates to see the impact of lambda.
Interpreting the results to understand how regularization prevents extreme coefficient values.
